rationale: Despite gapping down on negative earnings and trading below session VWAP ($12.64), the instrument is currently compressed into a tight 2-cent range ($12.45–$12.47) right on top of its 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.43) with an 8.0 bps spread. At 25.5% of the day's range, entering short offers poor distance to the session low ($12.27) relative to the noise and spread, while going long fights both the negative catalyst and the overhead VWAP.
